NORWALK, CT - November 3, 2026…Booking Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG) (the "Company," "we," "our," or "us") 
today reported its third quarter 2026 financial results.
● Room nights grew 7% compared to the third quarter of 2025. 
● Gross bookings grew 10% compared to the third quarter of 2025, or approximately 11% on a constant 
currency basis. 
● Revenue declined 1% compared to the third quarter of 2025, while Adjusted Revenue grew 9%, or
approximately 10% on a constant currency basis.
● Net income declined 1% compared to the third quarter of 2025, while Adjusted Net income and Adjusted
EBITDA grew 8% and 9%, respectively.
● GAAP EPS and Adjusted EPS grew 7% and 17%, respectively, compared to the third quarter of 2025.
